messages.subject: url paths as variables
parts:
I am not sure what this sort of functionality is called, but here is what I would like to be able to do.

Twitter, for example, creates a page for every twitter user like this:

www.twitter.com/username

... I want to do this also, but not have to create a directory for every user. I want the 'username' portion of the url to be fed to an element of the input variable called 'username':

input$username <- ['username' from url]

Is this doable with shiny?

Thank you.

Dan

messages.subject: Re: url paths as variables
parts:
See my post on persisting inputs via URLS

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups=#!searchin/shiny-discuss/alexbbrown/shiny-discuss/-33pTm2f4zo/WH2HMw328wwJ

For a partial solution using the URL hash.

I share your pain, so I built a mechanism that we can use for now, until a better one comes along.

Your URL might look like:

www.mytwitter.com/#user=alex

-Alex
